test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F and G, each has a different age. C is older than D. B is the oldest among all. E is older than G but younger than F. G is older than C. Only two people are younger than C. D is not the youngest. How many persons are younger than E?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) C is older than D 

⇒ **C **> D

2) **B is the oldest** among all 

3) E is older than G but younger than F 

⇒ F > E > G

4) G is older than C

⇒ F > E > **G** > C > D

5) Only two people are younger than C 

⇒ F > E > G > **C** > D > A

6) **D is not the youngest**

So, the correct order will be ⇒ B > **F > E > G > C > D > A** 

So, there are **4 persons** (G, C, D and A) younger than E.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
